info.title: Mastodon Social (Independent Publisher)
info.description: Mastodon is a free, open-source social network server based on ActivityPub. It is designed to be self-hosted and can be used to create a decentralized social network. This web service allows you to interact with Mastodon instances and perform various actions such as posting statuses, following users, and managing your account.
